Question: Elmo makes \(N\) sandwiches for a fundraiser. For each sandwich he uses \(B\) globs of peanut butter at \(4\)¢ per glob and \(J\) blobs of jam at \(5\)¢ per blob. The cost of the peanut butter and jam to make all the sandwiches is \(\$2.53.\) Assume that \(B,\) \(J,\) and \(N\) are positive integers with \(N \gt 1.\) What is the cost of the jam Elmo uses to make the sandwiches?
